atlas.orientation: Orthographic three-quarter overhead; docking approach toward screen bottom

frames.name: idle-closed
frames.description: Dock shutter closed; both maintenance arms folded beside the hull; low cyan guide lights

frames.name: docking-open
frames.description: Dock doors retracted outward; arms unfolded away from the bay; amber work lights

frames.name: service-active
frames.description: Open lit bay; arms articulated down and inward, tool pads toward the docking corridor

frames.name: departure-clear
frames.description: Open unobstructed bay; arms retracted upward; brighter cyan guide rails and amber beacon

playback.note: Four genuine mechanical states, not a high-frame-rate movement cycle. Hold each pose according to approach/service/departure; use the existing route clock and do not create another timer or RAF. Minor generative registration differences may remain between poses; crossfade briefly rather than claiming precision joint animation.
